# Jacob Orbach

> Full-stack developer, SaaS builder, and freelance full-stack developer based in
> Tel Aviv. Builds web products end to end — custom WordPress, React/Node/TypeScript
> applications, payment integrations — and grows them organically from zero traffic.

Jacob is unusual in combining two skill sets that are normally split between two
hires: shipping production software, and earning the organic search traffic that
makes it findable. He has taken his own products from launch to live paying
customers (GhostChat, Gmailytics, KaspaWoo), and separately built and grown six
web properties from zero organic traffic — the same work he does for clients.

## Services

- [Services overview](https://jacoborbach.com/services/): engagement models, process, and the six areas he works in.
- [Custom AI integration](https://jacoborbach.com/services/ai-integration/): LLM-powered support agents, retrieval-grounded answers, cost-controlled per-message model routing, prompt-injection-aware architecture. Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, and self-hosted Ollama. Publishes the open-source `ghostchat-agent` runner on npm and runs a Claude-based responder in production.
- [Payment integrations](https://jacoborbach.com/services/payment-integrations/): Stripe subscription billing, Meshulam SDK, custom WooCommerce payment gateways, non-custodial cryptocurrency payments, invoicing and reconciliation. Built a system processing $1M+/year.

## Proof

- [Portfolio and work history](https://jacoborbach.com/): shipped products, professional roles, testimonials, and technical stack.

## Products built

- [GhostChat](https://ghostchat.dev/): privacy-first chat widget, ~15KB SDK, 3-8x faster than legacy tools. Cloudflare Workers, Durable Objects, Supabase, Stripe.
- [Gmailytics](https://gmailytics.com/): Google CASA Tier 2 certified Gmail cleanup SaaS. 5.2M+ emails cleaned, 300GB storage freed.
- [KaspaWoo](https://kaspawoo.com/): open-source Kaspa cryptocurrency payment gateway for WooCommerce.
